title: The Pilgrim Has Packed for Every Century
description: A luminous American Romantic history painting of medieval Christian pilgrims approaching a great cathedral at dawn. A reverent procession carries beautifully embroidered crosses and candles; intricate stone tracery rises into golden mist. Space Ghost respectfully joins the pilgrims, carrying a ludicrously overpacked canvas knapsack with a tiny satellite dish protruding from it. Zorak studies an enormous upside-down medieval map. Historically observed wool, leather, pilgrim badges and carved stone; the joke belongs to the visitors, while the sacred setting is dignified.
